questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Among the halogens, which has the highest electron affinity?
questions.explanation: Despite being smaller, Fluorine has lower electron affinity due to strong inter-electron repulsion in its small 2p orbital. Chlorine has the highest electron affinity in the halogen group.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Frenkel defect is commonly found in:
questions.explanation: Frenkel defect occurs when an ion leaves its lattice site and occupies an interstitial site. AgBr shows this because Ag⁺ is small enough to fit into interstitial voids.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The acidic strength order of HF, HCl, HBr, HI is:
questions.explanation: Acidic strength increases as bond strength decreases down the group. H-I bond is weakest, thus HI is the strongest acid. Order: HI > HBr > HCl > HF.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following is the expanding agent in bread making?
questions.explanation: Saccharomyces cerevisiae (Baker's yeast) ferments sugar and produces CO₂ which makes the dough rise.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The pacemaker of the heart is:
questions.explanation: The Sinoatrial (SA) node generates the impulse for heartbeat and sets its rhythm. It is located in the right atrium.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which part of the brain controls body balance and posture?
questions.explanation: The Cerebellum coordinates voluntary muscle movements, maintains balance, and controls posture.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which type of RNA brings amino acids to the ribosome during translation?
questions.explanation: Transfer RNA (tRNA) carries specific amino acids to the ribosome, matching them to codon sequences on mRNA via its anticodon.
